doc.brief: `GtkAppChooserWidget` is a widget for selecting applications.
doc.deprecated_md:
The application selection widgets should be
  implemented according to the design of each platform and/or
  application requiring them.
doc.md:
`GtkAppChooserWidget` is a widget for selecting applications.

It is the main building block for [`AppChooserDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserDialog).
Most applications only need to use the latter; but you can use
this widget as part of a larger widget if you have special needs.

`GtkAppChooserWidget` offers detailed control over what applications
are shown, using the
[`AppChooserWidget:show-default`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#property:show-default),
[`AppChooserWidget:show-recommended`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#property:show-recommended),
[`AppChooserWidget:show-fallback`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#property:show-fallback),
[`AppChooserWidget:show-other`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#property:show-other) and
[`AppChooserWidget:show-all`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#property:show-all) properties. See the
[`AppChooser`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooser) documentation for more information about these
groups of applications.

To keep track of the selected application, use the
[`AppChooserWidget::application-selected`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#event:application-selected) and
[`AppChooserWidget::application-activated`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AppChooserWidget#event:application-activated) signals.

## CSS nodes

`GtkAppChooserWidget` has a single CSS node with name appchooser.

default-text.brief: The text that appears in the widget when there are no applications for the given content type.

The text that appears in the widget when there are no applications
for the given content type.

show-all.brief: If `TRUE`, the app chooser presents all applications in a single list, without subsections for default, recommended or related applications.
show-all.md:
If `TRUE`, the app chooser presents all applications
in a single list, without subsections for default,
recommended or related applications.

show-default.brief: Determines whether the app chooser should show the default handler for the content type in a separate section.
show-default.md:
Determines whether the app chooser should show the default
handler for the content type in a separate section.

If `FALSE`, the default handler is listed among the recommended
applications.

show-fallback.brief: Determines whether the app chooser should show a section for fallback applications.
show-fallback.md:
Determines whether the app chooser should show a section
for fallback applications.

If `FALSE`, the fallback applications are listed among the
other applications.

show-other.brief: Determines whether the app chooser should show a section for other applications.
show-other.md:
Determines whether the app chooser should show a section
for other applications.

show-recommended.brief: Determines whether the app chooser should show a section for recommended applications.
show-recommended.md:
Determines whether the app chooser should show a section
for recommended applications.

If `FALSE`, the recommended applications are listed
among the other applications.

application-activated.brief: Emitted when an application item is activated from the widget's list.
application-activated.md:
Emitted when an application item is activated from the widget's list.

This usually happens when the user double clicks an item, or an item
is selected and the user presses one of the keys Space, Shift+Space,
Return or Enter.

application-selected.brief: Emitted when an application item is selected from the widget's list.
application-selected.md: Emitted when an application item is selected from the widget's list.
